title: A strange all-in-one kitchen gadget
prompt: You and a friend are looking for a housewarming gift for someone who loves cooking. While browsing in a kitchen store, you see this unusual object. Phone your friend and describe it in as much detail as you can, and say what you think it is for. Your friend cannot see it.

structure: Greet your friend and say why you're calling (you found something unusual).
Describe the main body from bottom to top: base, screen and buttons, jar, lid, lemon squeezer.
Describe the unusual parts: the two arms with the whisk and the grater.
Guess what it's for, give the price and ask your friend's opinion.
modelAnswer: Hi Lan, it's me. I'm at the kitchen store, and I've found something really unusual that might work as a housewarming gift. It looks like an all-in-one cooking machine. At the bottom, there's a wide red base. On the front, there's a small blue digital screen showing the time, and next to it there are three round buttons: green, yellow and white. Sitting on top of the base is a clear jar, a bit like a blender jar, with measuring lines on the side and a blade at the bottom. It's got a green lid, and on top of the lid, there's a yellow dome with ridges. I'm pretty sure it's a lemon squeezer. Now here's the weird part: two metal arms are sticking out of the sides. The one on the left curves up and ends in a whisk, and the one on the right holds a round grater full of tiny holes. So I guess you could blend, whisk, grate and squeeze lemons with one machine. It's $89.99. What do you think?

commonMistakes: Không biết tên bộ phận thì im lặng; hãy dùng cách diễn đạt vòng: 'a round thing with tiny holes, like a cheese grater'.
Tả lộn xộn; nên đi theo một hướng cố định (dưới lên trên, trái sang phải).
Quên tính từ màu sắc, hình dạng, chất liệu (red, round, clear, metal) — đây là trọng tâm của Task 8.
